diagnosis_summary: The affected class-copy path copied each LearningClassActivity without cloning its related LearningActivity, so copied classes shared the original activity content. It also declared a newActivities list without adding the copied activities before the attribute-save loop. Rock confirmed and closed the issue with commit 454307680220a4c219dc006c6e8b69b5d32f53aa, which eagerly loads and clones each LearningActivity and adds each new class activity to the attribute-save list. The issue is labeled fixed in Rock 19.4; exact package inclusion should still be verified before treating an installed build as unaffected.
workaround_summaries: Use a Rock package proven to contain commit 454307680220a4c219dc006c6e8b69b5d32f53aa or an equivalent fix. Before upgrade, do not edit copied-class activity content under the assumption that it is independent; copy activities individually and verify each copied LearningClassActivity points to a distinct LearningActivity before changing content.

verification_playbook.goal: Detect learning activities referenced by more than one class before an agent edits copied-class content.
prerequisites: Know whether classes were copied with Include Activities enabled.
Have read-only SQL access to LMS relationship metadata.

steps.title: Check the installed copy path
steps.instructions: Verify whether LearningClassService.Copy still copies LearningClassActivity rows while retaining the original LearningActivity relationship.
steps.expected_if_affected: The class-copy path retains LearningActivityId while the individual activity-copy path creates a distinct LearningActivity.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: The installed package contains commit 454307680220a4c219dc006c6e8b69b5d32f53aa or an equivalent class-copy path that clones each related LearningActivity and preserves its attributes independently.

steps.title: Count cross-class activity sharing
steps.instructions: Return only the aggregate number of LearningActivity records referenced by more than one class. Do not return class IDs, names, learner data, content, or attribute values.
steps.probe: SELECT COUNT(*) AS SharedLearningActivityCount FROM (SELECT [LearningActivityId] FROM [LearningClassActivity] GROUP BY [LearningActivityId] HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT [LearningClassId]) > 1) shared
steps.expected_if_affected: SharedLearningActivityCount is greater than zero and the relevant classes came from the affected copy path; editing one shared activity can change more than one class.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: The count is zero, or every shared relationship has been independently reviewed as intentional rather than produced by class copy.

limitations: A shared LearningActivity can be intentional; the aggregate probe identifies review candidates but cannot determine provenance.
Do not edit an activity to test linkage in production.

context.scope: official GitHub fix release line; verify exact package inclusion
